outcome: Duration of first stage of labor
Duration of second stage of labor
Side effects (dry mouth, flushing, tachycardia, urinary retention)
cohort: 120 primigravida women at term in active labor
finding: Intravenous injection of hyoscine butylbromide (HBB) reduced the duration of the active phase of labor in primigravida women without significant side effects.
mod_finding: Intravenous injection of hyoscine butylbromide decreases the duration of active phase of labor in primigravidae.
